releaseNotes: Tempest v1.4.0 (by J. Borden): Meteorological storm-tracking overhaul (deep-convective VIL/Echo Top/dBZ gating eliminates shallow-shower false supercells, strict FROM->TOWARD motion vectors + NWS CAP vector parsing, erratic SCIT spike guard, and 8-mile multi-radar deduplication), tactical radar centerline vectors & 15/30/60 mi range rings, plus flagship obsidian UI with custom SVG weather graphics, live wind compass & barometer arc, and severity meters.
